title: Local prefix embedding
statement: For natural numbers $a$ and $K$ with $a\le K$, define the embedding from positions in a list of length $r+a$ into positions in a list of length $r+K$ that preserves the first $r$ positions and sends each of the remaining $a$ positions to the corresponding position among the final $K$ positions.
